errors.text: The proposed BCC matrix plus oxide precipitates is not a dual-phase solid-solution structure; the secondary phase is a ceramic precipitate rather than a second FCC or BCC solid solution.
The selected NbMoTaWVTi system and its 40 h milling/1400 °C SPS route do not reconstruct the CoCrFeNiTi system or its short-milling, 900–1000 °C processing window.
The claimed 0.5–1.0 wt% oxygen window, nanoscale FCC TiO constitution, coherency, sub-50 nm retained grain size, and fracture strain above 10% are not established by the cited evidence excerpts.

The first falsification criterion is logically inconsistent: formation of continuous oxide networks above 1.0 wt% oxygen confirms the proposed boundary rather than falsifying the mechanism within its claimed process window.
